authority_basis: G2R-01: ONE shared, scenario-agnostic phase policy for every phase-control scenario. Rules inspect ONLY generic evidence properties (channel grades, persistence floors from the frozen evaluation contract, structural level, DERIVED causal-signature recurrence, dependency centrality as a rigour modulator, data-quality blocker labels, unresolved-pattern state, prior review history, lineage diversity, explicit resolution conditions). No scenario id, no literal signature/scope/mechanism name, no outcome-shaped predicate appears anywhere.

rules.rationale: any material tension opens WATCH (entry bar below escalation; grades inherited from the frozen contract)
sustained contradiction escalates for adverse review (investigation, not transformation)
sustained failure/exception load escalates for review
persistent, INDEPENDENTLY-LINEAGED structural contradiction; centrality raises rigour, never immunity; absence of a centrality claim is not a blocker
DERIVED same-signature pressure reaching structural level L3 with recurrence >= 3; unrelated signatures never aggregate
local repairs at implementation/procedure level are reasonable while the shared cause is hidden
a leaf-level affected surface (L1) is repaired locally and must remain narrow
persistent independently-lineaged contradiction opens the transformation window
a structural-fault episode completes the window into reconsolidation
unresolved multiplicity completes the window into reconsolidation
no global dominance established; an explicit non-domination condition preserves both models
a NEW_STABLE epoch requires a REPLACEMENT_VALIDATED resolution that follows a genuine, UNSULILIED structural episode; a quiet baseline or a data-quality-defective episode can never mint one
a review that found nothing structural closes as NO_CHANGE at review depth only
repair verified / quiet load closes to STABLE
recovery to pre-tension evidence; not the mechanical inverse of entry
